messages:
Ellen (CEO): Quick weekly note — high level: uptime steady, revenue green, but two action areas: reliability hardening and ramping Dedicated sales. Details below.
Sam (VP Eng): Thanks — quick status: 99.96% platform uptime last week, median 95th p95 gen latency 140ms after the kernel patch.
Maya (Head of Product): Product update: beta for Private VPC pilot kicked off with 3 customers. Feature flags enabled for audit-logging and KMS integration. First pilot feedback: need clearer onboarding doc for key rotation.
Jordan (SRE Lead): Incident recap: 02:14 UTC transient GPU scheduler bug — affected 0.9% of requests, failover to fallback models succeeded. Root cause: edge case in preemption handling. Postmortem in eng-sre channel; mitigation: patch + automated canary for preemption in next deploy.
Ellen (CEO): Great catch, Jordan. Please ensure customer-impacting incidents bubble up to the exec thread within 1 hour next time. Also we should notify any Dedicated customers in the pilot with a short blurb.
Sam (VP Eng): Action items I own: (1) schedule reliability sprint next week (2) add preemption canary to deploy pipeline (3) run a cost/latency analysis on fallback models. ETA: Wed EOD for canary.
Maya (Head of Product): Product action: update onboarding doc and add a short KMS rotation checklist. I'll put a PR by Tuesday. Also starting prep for Dedicated pricing webinar for next Friday.
Jordan (SRE Lead): Postmortem TL;DR will include timeline, root cause, impact, and verification steps. I’ll post the ops runbook updates once the patch lands.
deploy-bot: deploy-1723 succeeded (canary -> prod) :white_check_mark: — started at 1776543450, finished at 1776543495.
Ellen (CEO): Business metrics: MRR +12% QoQ, net new logos from self-serve improving. Focus for next week: (A) close 2 Dedicated pilots to contracts (B) reduce p95 generation latency by 10% (C) finalize data-retention policy update and comms.
Sam (VP Eng): On data-retention policy: ops suggests default 90d token logs with opt-in for 12mo retention for enterprise. Security to sign off and comms team to prepare template. I’ll loop in security.
Maya (Head of Product): Comms draft for pilot customers: short note + change log + link to onboarding doc. Will share in #product for review today.
Ellen (CEO): Two final asks: 1) Everyone, highlight blockers in your standups related to Dedicated deals or Private pilots. 2) Exec sync moved to Thurs 09:00 PT this week. Thanks team :rocket:
thread_text_brief: CEO weekly: reliability, Dedicated ramp, Private pilot, incident recap, action items, metrics
